CENs learn a class of models that generate explanations and use them for prediction and that CENs outperform state-of-the-art methods in low-resource settings.

CENs (i) learn to predict and explain jointly, (ii) generate instance-specific explanations for each prediction, (iii) offer insights about the decision-making process of the model, and (iv) improve model performance in low-resource regimes.
